name: Tests
description: Shows whether the tests pass without reading a terminal, and hands a failure to an agent in one click. Agents read the last result instead of running everything again.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs a hook after each Bash and PowerShell call that reads the output of a test run and keeps its result in the kit's own data folder; a tab reads it and, when you click, sends a failure to an agent of the workspace.
